description: This Java source file defines the MainPhoneActivity class for an Android application that manages interactions between a mobile device and a connected wear device. It handles runtime permissions, communication via GoogleApiClient with wearables, and responses to permission requests and data exchanges. The class implements multiple interfaces for connection handling, capability monitoring, message listening, and result callbacks, facilitating bidirectional messaging and user permission management for external storage and sensors.

classes.name: MainPhoneActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that interfaces with connected wearable devices via GoogleApiClient, manages runtime permission requests, and facilitates communication and data exchange between the phone and wearables.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and prepares GoogleApiClient for connecting to wearable APIs.

methods.name: onClickWearBodySensors
methods.description: Handles user interaction to request data from the wearable device.

methods.name: onClickPhoneStorage
methods.description: Handles user interaction to display phone storage info or request permission.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Disconnects GoogleApiClient and removes listeners when activity is paused.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Re-establishes GoogleApiClient connection and checks permissions when activity resumes.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from permission rationale activity.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Callback when GoogleApiClient connects; sets up capability and message listeners and initiates capability checks.

methods.name: onCapabilityChanged
methods.description: Updates internal node list when capability info changes.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Processes incoming messages from wearable devices to handle permission responses and data.

methods.name: onResult
methods.description: Callback for message sending result, updates UI based on success or failure.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to connected wearable nodes with specified DataMap.

methods.name: updateWearButtonOnUiThread
methods.description: Updates the UI button to reflect wearable permission status.

methods.name: logToUi
methods.description: Thread-safe method to log messages and update UI components.

methods.name: getPhoneStorageInformation
methods.description: Retrieves and formats list of files in external storage.

methods.name: sendWearPermissionResults
methods.description: Sends permission approval or denial results back to the wearable device.
